note: Opponent prior: every eligible measured team of data/team-inventory-v1 (belief-pool-v2 plus mjj-2020-kb-2020, whose open-era dominated verdict is not reconfirmed under blind c = 0.4). weight = 1/(members of its variant cluster in this prior), x0.25 for machine-generated teams; weighted identification and weighted-mode fallback (crates/bot/src/belief.rs). Sets use training-v3 normalization. v1Label is the historical open-era label, not the selection label. See data/belief-pool-v3/README.md.

trainingNormalization.constraints: Preserve loadout, public gender, shiny status and Hidden Power type. Maximize HP/non-Attack stats and Hidden Power power; maximize usable Attack, otherwise minimize it. Maximize Return/Frustration power.
